# `invalidated-container-view`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a slice or iterator used after an operation that may move or invalidate
its container's backing storage.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Growth and structural mutation can leave previously obtained views pointing at
stale memory or state.

## When it fires

It applies to recognized local containers and container fields followed by known
invalidating operations on the same container, and to a view retained across
`realloc` of its source allocation.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn update(allocator: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    var list = std.ArrayList(u8).empty;
    const old_items = list.items;
    try list.append(allocator, 1);
    consume(old_items);
}

fn consume(items: []const u8) void {
    _ = items;
}
```
